articles.title: Introducing workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
articles.author: Roy Allela
articles.summary: Large training jobs can fail even when every node looks healthy. A GPU with a subtle fault can pass its stress tests and still return wrong values. When a job stalls on an NCCL timeout, it keeps its GPUs, and Slurm still shows it as running. If a device plugin crashes on one node, the job fails with an error that never mentions the plugin. Teams usually find these problems only after the loss diverges or the job fails, and by then the compute is spent. Each of these failures lowers goodput, the share of your cluster’s time that goes to useful training. Today, we’re introducing workload recovery and infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod that catch these failures sooner and raise the goodput of your training workloads. articles.title: Resilience testing your agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
articles.author: Richard Whitworth
articles.summary: When an artificial intelligence (AI) agent’s tools start failing (a database query times out, an API returns incorrect data, a search call silently drops fields), what does your agent do? Does it retry, fall back, or acknowledge it can’t complete the task? Or does it present a confident answer built on corrupted data, show the user a raw error, or fail silently with no alert to your operations team? These aren’t hypothetical scenarios. In production, tool calls fail, networks partition, upstream services degrade, and agent-generated queries return incomplete results. If you’ve never tested how your agent behaves under those conditions, you’re relying on assumptions, not evidence. With AWS Fault Injection Service (AWS FIS), you can test how your Strands agent handles tool-level faults...

articles.summary: 就在昨天，The Game Awards（TGA）公布了 2026 年的提名名单—— 其中，《GTA VI》一口气获得了 8 项提名领跑榜单，包括年度游戏、最佳游戏指导、最佳叙事、最佳美术指导等重要奖项，就连饰演女主角 Lucia 的 Manni L. Perez 也获得了最佳表演提名。 问题是，当时距离《GTA VI》正式发售还有一天。 尽管按照 TGA 的评选规则，评审团可以提前体验游戏，《GTA VI》也「恰好」赶上了今年的资格截止日期，所以这次提名完全符合规则，只是场面多少有些奇妙： 玩家还在倒数游戏解锁时间，游戏行业已经开始讨论它今年能拿多少奖了。 甚至可以说，相比《GTA VI》需要 TGA 的认可，TGA 可能更需要《GTA VI》出现在今年的颁奖典礼上。 而在 Metacritic 上，《GTA VI》也已经冲到了历史第一。 截至 18 日晚，游戏凭借 146 篇媒体评测拿下了 99 分，追平《塞尔达传说：时之笛》保持的历史最高分纪录，也刷新了《GTA》系列的评分纪录。 如今，《GTA VI》终于正式发售——毫无疑问这是今年最重要的游戏，或者说，《GTA VI》无论在哪一年发售，都会是当年最受瞩目的游戏。 Rockstar 终于带着玩家回到了熟悉的罪恶都市。 爱范儿也第一时间为你带来游戏的上手体验。 在罪恶都市，随便走走都有新发现 我们在 PS5 和 Xbox Series X 上体验了《GTA VI》的序章。 刚进游戏，最直接的感受就是，它的画面表现几乎领先了同时代游戏一个量级。光线反射、暗部细节、水体效果和城市景观都极其精细，尤其是场景中的人物密度与建模质量，给人留下了很深的印象。 光是这个序章，就已经让我们对 Rockstar 这些年的投入有了更直观的认识。 在《GTA...

articles.summary: In June we introduced the Open Knowledge Format (OKF), an open specification that provides plain markdown and YAML to give agents the context they need. In July, v0.2 added trust signals: provenance, trust, freshness, lifecycle, and attestation. In production, bundles move between organizations, multiple agents edit the same corpus, and independent tools need to read a bundle the same way. Released today, OKF v0.3 adds precise conformance rules, trust tiers that keep pace with agent edits, self-describing bundles with licensing, safe ways to retire and move knowledge, a stable extension model, and a clear versioning policy. articles.summary: TL;DR: Single-stack IPv6 on GKE runs both nodes and pods without having to use private IPv4 addresses. Available in preview for Cloud TPU v6e and CPU node pools, including Axion, it works with DNS64/NAT64 to reach IPv4 endpoints. Long before they run out of compute or power, AI applications hit another wall: running out of IP addresses. A single AI deployment often requires a vast address space to support everything from thousands of accelerator nodes, scaling inference replicas, bursting Ray workers and pipelines, pod sidecars, and services like vector databases. Running a dual stack — IPv6 behind a private IPv4 space — can help, but only to a point, because the private IPv4 space has often already been exhausted across existing networks. articles.title: Sashiko: Lessons from building an agentic code review system for Linux
articles.summary: The speed of development in large open-source projects has always been limited by code review, not code generation. Even as coding agents get better at writing code, they do not accelerate development on their own. This is especially true of patches to the Linux kernel. Without a way to build trust in proposed changes, more generated code simply piles up in front of the same small group of human maintainers. Some of those patches are solid changes, just written faster; many others are plausible-looking "AI slop" sent by contributors who do not fully understand the systems they are modifying. And the influx of AI-generated security reports, many of which are duplicates or inaccurate, only adds to maintainers’ load. articles.summary: #碎碎念淘宝上架一个商品，要走的步骤是拼多多的好几倍。买家端也一样：淘宝要选规格、比店铺、算满减凑单，拼多多点开就拼成。多数人把拼多多赢归结为便宜。便宜是结果，原因是漏斗的层数。用第一性原理拆开，一个产品的实际覆盖人数大致是：触达人群 ×（1 - 单步流失率）^步数步数写在右上角。走 7 步，每步留下 90%，最后只剩 48%。走 3 步，同样的单步损耗，还剩 73%。差的不是五毛钱的设计感，是整整一半的人。所以下沉市场不是拼多多挑中的，是淘宝的漏斗替它筛完了。那些“不太会用 App”的中老年和农村用户，本来一直都在，只是卡在了第三、第四步。大道至简的商业解释就这么朴素：你少要一步，就多要一层人。功能是加法，覆盖是乘法，而乘法里最贵的那一项，叫“这一步算了”。当然有边界。专业工具的用户本来就需要复杂，简单也不是唯一的赢法。但当你的目标是覆盖，少一步就是最便宜的增长手段。🙊💬1🔄0❤️0👀945📊1⚡ Powered by xgo.ing

articles.summary: 学到了 原来 vitest 有一个 vitest --changed 命令，vitest.dev/config/changed…它只会跑 changed files 相关的 tests，内部原理是 Vitest 会让 Git 给出变更文件列表，然后找出 import 了这些文件 的测试文件，只要测试的 import grahp 里面有这个文件，就会运行对应的测试，这个命令非常实用啊Viking@vikingmute非常实用的加速 CI 的经验，学到很多新知识，尤其是对加速测试的方式 ：* 把测试按照历史耗时智能分片并行跑 ，如果平均分配的话，有可能出现时间消耗非常不一致的情况，所以先记录每个测试的历史耗时，按耗时把测试重新分配，然后让每个分片的总时间尽量接近，这个真的是巧思* PR 只跑受影响的测试，根据代码 diff 只执行相关测试，而不是全量，这里执行哪些应该是在 CI 上做静态分析 import graph，然后决定跑哪些* 其他还有换工具纯纯提速，tsc 改成 bun check，lint 使用 oxlint* 最后就是所有都并行，lint/类型检查/build/test同时跑🔗 View Quoted Tweet💬1🔄4❤️32👀5194📊11⚡ Powered by xgo.ing

articles.title: 当 AI 研发下一代 AI，人类研究员还剩下什么？|S10E36
articles.author: 声动活泼
articles.summary: 如果有一天，AI 不仅能够回答问题、编写代码，还能够参与研发下一代 AI，甚至不断改进自己，人工智能的发展速度会发生怎样的变化？最近半年, RSI（Recursive Self-Improvement，递归自进化）的研究方向受到越来越多的关注。它描绘了一种可能的未来：AI 参与研发更强大的 AI，而新一代 AI 又能够进一步提升研发效率，形成持续迭代的循环。本期节目，我们邀请到前微软亚洲研究院副院长、现中关村人工智能研究院杰出技术专家边江，一起讨论 AI for AI 和 RSI 的技术进展，以及它们可能给人工智能产业带来的深远影响。我们从 AI 如何提出研究假设、执行实验、积累经验聊起，探讨 AI 能否发现全新的算法和科学规律。当 AI 越来越擅长科学研究，人类科学家的价值究竟在哪里？所谓科研中的「品味」（Taste），是否也能够被 AI 学习？面对模型、算力和数据上的巨大差距，AI 初创公司还有哪些机会？中国团队又该如何参与这场竞争？当 AI 开始参与创造下一代 AI，我们或许正在见证人工智能研发方式的一次重要转变。本期人物边江，中关村人工智能研究院杰出技术专家，前微软亚洲研究院副院长Yaxian，「科技早知道」主播主要话题[00:00] 当 AI 开始研发 AI，我们距离真正的递归自进化还有多远？让十几位研究人员与 300 多个 AI Agent 协作，在四五个月内完成一个 400B 模型的后训练，展现了 AI 参与研发带来的效率提升。AI for AI 是利用 AI 参与人工智能系统的研发与优化，而真正的 RSI（递归自进化）意味着新一代 AI 能够反过来提升下一轮 AI 的研发能力。从传统 AutoML 到如今的研发 Agent，大模型的知识储备、推理能力和编程能力，让 AI 有机会自主提出研究假设、执行实验，并根据反馈持续调整优化方向。[09:46] AI...

articles.title: 一份看空中际旭创的报告，戳中了AI硬件的最大软肋
articles.summary: 原创 硅基君 2026-11-18 19:00 北京 AI硬件，终究逃不过周期 一份看空中际旭创的估值测算，几乎把整个AI硬件资产的估值困境摆到了台面上。11月17日，一份关于中际旭创的看空测算在投资圈迅速传播。按照这份材料的预测，到2029年，中际旭创的年净利润大约只有300亿元，对应合理市值3000亿至4500亿元。考虑到折现因素，即使在最乐观的情况下，公司目前的股价仍然存在约25%的回撤空间。这份测算一出，便迅速引发了极大的争议。要知道，中际旭创今年的业绩可以说相当惊人。2026年前三季度，公司实现营业收入695.47亿元，同比增长178.13%；归母净利润222.38亿元，同比增长211.81%。按此计算，归母净利率接近32%。不仅的经营数据仍然相当强劲，订单、产品价格和毛利率并没有出现明显恶化。卖方机构甚至还在不断上调盈利预期。10月底，华泰证券预计中际旭创2026年至2028年的归母净利润分别达到335亿元、807亿元和1132亿元。一边是2028年净利润突破千亿元的乐观预期，另一边却是2029年净利润只有300亿元的看空测算。对于中际旭创这样一家备受市场关注的AI硬件龙头，未来盈利预期竟然能相差数倍，实在少见。事实上，中际旭创面临的分歧，也是整个AI硬件的缩影。就在今天，英伟达公布了最新三季报，营收依然保持着惊人的增长。但另一边，随着股价回落，其预期市盈率已经降至约12倍，创下2012年以来的低位。明明业绩还在高速增长，市场却对AI硬件资产产生了巨大的担忧。这也是为什么一份建立在2029年假设之上的测算，会在此时引起如此大的反应。/ 01...

articles.author: 爱范儿
articles.summary: 在 AI 编码工具与智能体技术快速普及的今天，软件开发的门槛正在发生微妙的变化。当编写代码不再是计算机专业学生的专属技能，越来越多来自设计、物理、统计等不同学科的年轻人，开始尝试亲手将脑海里的设想变成可运行的应用。 一个随之而来的问题是：当技术实现不再构成绝对阻碍，这届大学生最想用代码解决什么问题？答案，就藏在刚刚收官的一场国家级赛事里。 11 月 15 日，2026 年「中国高校计算机大赛—人工智能创意赛」总决赛在南京大学落下帷幕。这项创办于 2018 年的赛事，今年首次由华为联合承办，鸿蒙高校创新赛也正式纳入官方赛道，短短数月便吸引全国 800 多所高校、近 5000 支队伍、近万名学子提交了 2800 多份有效作品。 华为终端BG CEO 何刚出席了颁奖现场，并宣布推出「鸿蒙高校创新孵化计划」，通过提供 1V1 技术指导、全周期产品打磨、商业模式指导、商业变现实战、平台技术赋能、上架流程指导、应用市场专区曝光及官方矩阵宣发等支持。 通过这套孵化机制，华为希望伴随好创意走完从教室、赛场到真实市场的完整生命周期。「我们希望更多同学加入我们的比赛，让作品有机会成为消费者能够体验到的产品，这也是鸿蒙生态发展下一步的节奏。」何刚表示。 翻开日常的「褶皱」，找到藏着的痛点 翻看鸿蒙赛道决赛圈 51 支队伍的背景，能明显感受到一种打破传统工科竞赛的跨界气息：「万象有序」由产品设计与物理学强基计划的学生跨校组成；「灵触随行」由统计学学生牵头；主打智能穿搭的「MORPHIA」，则集结了水下机器人与软件工程专业的研究生。 他们在调用鸿蒙系统能力时展现出了一种清醒的「工程克制感」——不迷信 AI 的全权接管，而是用代码为弱势群体和普通人保留尊重与选择权。...

articles.title: 这届减脂年轻人，把迪卡侬吃成赵一鸣
articles.summary: 象树 2026-11-18 18:45 北京 以下文章来源于：惊蛰青年 惊蛰青年 一座Z世代博物馆。 零食都挑难吃的，还有谁能比我更健康？ 来源丨新周刊-惊蛰青年（ID：wakinglism）作者丨象树编辑丨安菲尔德图源丨Midjourney下定决心减肥的第一天，陈妍下载了三套帕梅拉教程，列好了一份采购清单：运动内衣、瑜伽垫、哑铃，准备从置办装备开始，给自己的健身计划一个正式的开场。陈妍来到家附近的迪卡侬，在一排一排货架之间，按图索骥地寻找清单上的装备。她的消费计划很明确，新手没必要做“装备党”，买齐基础三件套就回家，绝不恋战。靠近收银台时，陈妍发现，一块空地上错落摆放着几个货架篮，里面满满当当装着各种零食：9.9元一包的果泥，12.9元一袋的冻干水果，旁边的落地货架上还摆着14.9元一袋的巧克力和小饼干。迪卡侬的小零食。（图/安菲尔德 摄）在某股神秘力量的驱使下，走出迪卡侬时，陈妍拎的购物袋里比预想中沉了不少，迪卡侬的热门零食几乎被一网打尽。这种相似的体验，很多人都有过。走进迪卡侬之前，人设明明是管住嘴、迈开腿的自律都市丽人，结账的时候，莫名奇妙就退行成了春游前采购的小学生。至于说好的减肥呢？谁说不减了，这一大袋子蛋卷软糖小饼干，哪一个不是低卡低脂配料表干净的好零食？运动品牌的零食，怎么能算放纵餐呢！“既要又要”的减肥人一吃一个不吱声出于好奇也好，满足嘴馋也罢，又或者只是想给枯燥难熬的减脂期添几分慰藉，像陈妍一样，在迪卡侬“顺手”买了一大袋零食的人不在少数。社交媒体上，迪卡侬的零食甚至已经红到有人专门为它出测评了。小红书#迪卡侬零食#...

articles.title: 从 AI 面试助手到蒸馏广告投手，他是怎么找到下一门生意的？｜对谈 Michael Guan（Hellyeah）
articles.author: 徐文浩，任鑫

articles.title: 从研发经验到团队知识：Akashic知识工程实践｜得物技术

articles.summary: 原创 大王叫我来巡山 2026-11-18 18:10 广东 所有事情都要一个人来做吗？ FDE不是"什么都会的超级员工"，而是一支分工明确的现场小队。Palantir把现场团队拆成Echo（懂客户）、Delta（搞落地）、Dev（做平台）三种角色；而让这套模式跑起来的，不是个人能力，而是经验回流和激励对齐两个机制。———— / BEGIN / ————如果你最近在看 FDE（前沿部署工程师）的招聘信息或科普文章，多半会看到这样的描述：懂业务、能写代码、会交付。职位要求里贴满了“需求调研、产品设计、现场实施、用户支持、反馈迭代”，一个岗位的职责表上能写满两屏。这样很容易让人产生误解：FDE 就是那种什么都会、什么都得做的超级员工。但这个理解只对了一半。真正的问题是：端到端负责，就一定意味着所有事情都要一个人来做吗？ 并不是。一、「全能岗」误解的由来把一个岗位的所有职责堆在一个职位描述里，这是JD的通病。而且不只是 FDE，其他岗位也是这样。小红书上有个科普笔记把 FDE 描述成“业务、技术与交付的连接者”，画出一条从调研到上线再到迭代的完整流程，配了清爽的信息图。从科普的角度来讲，这个图没什么问题，但逻辑上有点不对：职位的多面性和“一个人什么都干”是两码事。作为一个角色，FDE 确实要懂这些领域、要在这些环节里做决定、要对交付的结果负责。但这不等于所有工作都由一个人完成。现场的问题需要他识别、需要他和产品团队对接、需要他推动，但代码改进未必要他亲手写。客户的需求需要他理解、需要他判断可行性、需要他跟进，但底层的技术方案可能来自另一个人。这正是 FDE 能成为一个可靠的模式，而不是只能是初创小团队临时抱佛脚的原因。二、FDE 的原型其实是一支队伍Palantir 是现在行业里公开谈 FDE 最详细的公司。他们在招聘页面上把现场团队分成三个互相支撑的角色。Echo...

articles.title: Vol.292｜施展×刘擎：从阴山互市到上海口岸，碰撞中的秩序生成
articles.author: 大观天下志
articles.summary: 2011年，在坦桑尼亚的一处路边小摊上，施展看到了一个印着喜羊羊的书包。一个来自中国的普通商品，出现在万里之外的非洲，让他第一次直观感受到中国超大规模性对世界的影响。此后，他开始从历史中寻找答案：这种规模性从何而来，又是在怎样的互动中逐渐形成的？本期节目，施展邀请长期在上海生活的刘擎教授，围绕古代北方的阴山互市、近代上海开埠和当代全球规则的重塑，一起讨论异质人群交往中规则如何生成。明代面临边防困局，隆庆朝开放东南海禁、允许明蒙互市后，贸易带来了和平；到了近代，上海开埠后涌入苏北、宁波、广东乃至外国等各方人群，在交往中逐步创造了以契约为主导的交往规则；今天，中国仍在参与全球规则和秩序的重塑，特斯拉上海超级工厂的生产力，为马斯克构想的未来提供了落地杠杆。异质人群相遇常带来戒备与冲突，但好奇让人愿意试探、交易和磨合，而规则正是在冲突的张力与好奇的开放中生长出来。——本期节目由【河山三万里】和【汇丰卓越理财·尊尚】特约呈现。尊尚，更赴心境。【本期对谈】施展（上海外国语大学全球文明史研究所教授）刘擎（华东师范大学紫江特聘教授）【收听指南】02:32 在非洲看到喜羊羊书包，第一次直观感受中国的超大规模性07:13 秩序的形成：古代的农牧冲突、近代的海陆碰撞、今天的中国与世界11:32 隆庆朝开放东南海禁、允许明蒙互市，贸易带来了和平14:26 从乡土中国到上海口岸：差序格局与陌生人世界的契约规则18:01 关税与厘金：上海开埠，大清获得了新的财政来源22:30 上海话、户口制度、本地主义与城市生活的变迁25:18 秩序与自由：规则为什么需要不断激发、不断调整29:08 特斯拉上海工厂：中国的超级生产能力与马斯克的未来构想34:05 冲突与好奇：新的规则与秩序，总是在交往界面上开始生长【工具箱】01...

articles.author: meng shao (@shao__meng)
articles.summary: Cognition 推出 Devin Bots：从接单写代码，到带领多个 Agent 持续负责一项工程目标Devin Bots 想解决的不只是「Agent 能不能完成这次任务」，是任务结束之后，谁来发现下一件事、检查效果，并继续推进。与一次请求对应一次执行的 Devin 会话不同，Bot 是持续存在的工程队友：拥有独立身份、记忆和工具权限，能拆解目标，启动多个 Devin 会话并行工作，再跟进测试、代码审查和后续改进。# 交给它的不是工单，是一项职责一个很直观的区别：不要求「把这个功能移植到 Android」，让 Bot「持续保持 Android 与 iOS 的功能对等」；不「修复这次布局跳动」，而「在产品不断改动时，持续保持页面流畅」。前者交付一次就结束，后者需要不断发现差距、安排工作、验证结果。Devin Bots 把这层持续协调也纳入了产品。Bot 可以按日程运行，也能由工具里的事件触发，例如关注 Slack 中的客户问题、每晚检查 CI，或跟进 Linear 中的阻塞事项。创建时可以从 QA、产品开发、性能优化等模板起步，再配置具体职责。# Bot 负责统筹，Devin 会话负责执行每个 Bot 有一条持续对话，承接目标、反馈和进展。它拆出的具体工作，会在独立云端机器上启动 Devin 子会话，执行方式与工程师直接启动 Devin 相同。这里有两种长期信息：一类是人设定的指令，明确职责和工作方式；另一类是 Bot 在工作中积累的记忆，包括偏好、纠正和项目细节。共享给团队后，大家可以围绕同一个 Bot 协作，不必每次重新交代背景。Bot 之间也能派活。官方演示中，QA Bot 发现问题后交给 Developer Bot 修复，再回来验证。人不需要手动搬运每一步上下文，而是重点处理目标调整和关键判断。# Android 应用案例，展示了持续负责的含义Cognition...

articles.title: 动线Agent：AI驱动的全链路用户转化引导
articles.summary: 原创 淘特用户技术团队 2026-11-18 16:37 浙江 本文介绍了淘特App推出的动线Agent——一套由大模型（LLM）驱动的全链路用户转化引导系统。针对近90%到端用户未完成转化的痛点，该系统围绕用户旅程（ 进端/在端/离端 ）部署了三个差异化智能体。三者均取得显著业务增益，整体峰值增量GMV占比超大盘5%，且通过技术手段将token成本降低60%以上。未来将推动三端从数据回流走向共享决策状态，构建统一的用户智能体。摘要在注意力经济时代，短视频足够好刷，游戏和内容 App 也在持续争夺用户时间。如果用户打开了一个购物 App，本身就是一次昂贵且高价值的行为。一般电商App 的访购率约为百分之十几，这意味着近百分八九十的到端用户并没有完成转化。从入端到成交，用户并不会沿着一条直线前进，而是会经历浏览、比较、犹豫、放弃与回归，如何在这个过程中完成对用户的转化引导？本文提出 动线 Agent —— 一套面向淘特场景、由 LLM 驱动的全链路用户引导系统。它围绕用户「进端 → 在端 → 离端」三个核心时机，部署三个差异化的智能体，构建三种互补的决策模式：TensorLiftAgent（精细化模式）于进端时机，通过多维用户特征张量分解，生成网格人群和差异化的权益策略，后台天级寻优、入端毫秒命中，结合AB 实验持续汰换策略做大SOTA桶；PeiAgent（快决策模式）于在端时机，端云协同实时计算用户的个性化购物热情指数（PEI, Purchase Enthusiasm Index），当判断用户的指数衰减达到某个阈值，立即触发基于行为序列与意图的AI推理的权益干预；DeepFlowAgent（慢思考模式）于离端未购时机，异步执行长链 CoT 深度归因推理，生成个性化权益与营销话术并多渠道召回。效果上，三个模式均上线并达到一定规模效果：进端增益 ROI...

articles.summary: OpenAI 给 GPT-6.2 的 Codex 提示建议：先说验收标准，再按任务选推理强度OpenAI 在这份指南里写，GPT-6.2 Astra 比 GPT-6 Astra 更容易给出接近可用的初稿：代码更好读，写作更直接，视觉作品也更完整。这些提示方法适用于整个 GPT-6.2 系列，包括 Astra 和 Sol，重点是在 Codex 里把任务说清楚，并告诉它你会按什么标准验收。指南建议，像跟熟悉项目的同事交代工作一样描述需求，同时写明验收时会看什么。比如图标必须在 24 像素工具栏里仍能辨认，就直接说出来。Codex 可以从现有图标里抓住风格，并判断在这个尺寸下该保留多少细节。learn.chatgpt.com/guides/prompti…按调查深度选择推理强度更高的推理强度，能让模型在长时间任务里坚持做到最后的检查，即使最终答案只有几行。关键是先说清什么叫完成，以及哪些地方必须穷尽。如果团队要的是一项建议，可能意味着要把一条有希望的线索推到足够远，再拿去对照其他解释。选择推理强度，看的是调查有多深：快速浏览可以用 Medium；追查一个可能的原因、并跨越多个系统时，适合用 High；当多个原因可能相互影响、调查需要逐一交代时，再考虑 Extra High。让并行工作变成可授权的默认选择当任务可以拆成几块独立推进时，明确告诉 Codex 按需使用子 agent，等于授权它自己判断何时并行、如何分工。如果这类工作经常出现，就把这条写进对应的 skill 或 AGENTS.md，并说明适用场景。比如研究类技能，可以规定：请求里包含多个独立问题时再启用。使用 Ultra 时，Codex 会自己决定要不要引入子 agent。指南建议把它留给能干净拆开、又足够深入的任务，例如开放式研究里每一问都值得单独深挖。每个子 agent...

articles.author: meng shao (@shao__meng)
articles.summary: Airbnb 用 Presidio 做文本去标识：把真实信息换成可训练的假数据训练模型前，Airbnb 会先处理消息、评价和客服对话里的个人信息：按公司统一分类，把姓名、住址、支付信息等替换成尽量逼真的模拟数据，既减少真实信息的副本和泄露，也尽量保留训练价值。政策由 Privacy Architecture 团队会同法务、政策和工程制定，再落实为代码。medium.com/airbnb-enginee…做成共享训练步骤，不另建中心服务他们以开源库 Presidio 为基础。它最初由 Microsoft 开发，现已交由社区治理，以 Python 包在调用进程内运行。但只有每条流水线都使用当前版本和合规配置，保护才会生效。因此它被做成共享机器学习工作流中的可复用步骤，使用方只需标明哪些字段含有个人信息。处理后的数据集会打上去标识标记，进入模型注册表，用来把关生产部署，并记录所用版本和配置。训练前还会先过滤已选择退出的记录。用模式匹配和 GLiNER 识别，再用假值填回Analyzer 先标出疑似个人信息的片段和置信度，Anonymizer 再处理重叠并替换。有固定形态的标识，用正则加上下文词识别。多种编号都可能是一串数字，他们扩展了短语级匹配，让更具体的词组优先得分。默认的 spaCy 会把城市、地标也标成地点，在他们的评测中往往覆盖不到带门牌号的完整住址。姓名和地点因此改用可在推理时指定「街道地址」的 GLiNER。团队写道，两类实体的精确率都有提升；GLiNER2 已接入评测，只有基准证明有增益时才会换上。语言按整条记录或区域元数据判断，不稳时改用更保守的配置。替换不用占位符或空白，以免模型把「这里被删过」也学成一种模式，大多数类型用 faker...

articles.title: AI 越聪明，世界越单调
articles.summary: 发现明日产品的 2026-11-18 14:51 北京 以下文章来源于：APPSO APPSO AI 第一新媒体，「超级个体」的灵感指南。 #AIGC #智能设备 #独特应用 #Generative AI 我们对 AI 的信任，正在达到史无前例的高度。无论是在屏幕前码字，还是在生活中做决策，我们都习惯向 AI 寻求那个「完美建议」。用得多了，你甚至会发现它总是精准地踩中我们预期中的最优解。这种顺滑，很可能是一种被精心设计的心理按摩。哥伦比亚大学教授桑德拉·马茨用冰淇淋店 Baskin Robbins 做了一个实验。这家店以「31 种口味」著称，每天换一种，整整一个月不重样。但当她把挑选口味的决策权交给 ChatGPT 时，这个拥有海量口味的品牌，在 AI 眼里基本只有两个选择——「核桃奶油」和「薄荷巧克力碎片」。她重复问了 100 次，ChatGPT 96 次都只给出了这两个选项。桑德拉·马茨在 TEDx 演讲中说道：「如果长期如此，Baskin Robbins 最终可能只剩下这两种口味——因为如果没人再选另外 29 种，商家为什么还要继续提供呢？」演讲指路👉：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ff4S1FJdRM\&t=392s桑德拉·马茨认为， AI 在无意间「压平」了人类的选择多样性。算法之所以如此擅长预测我们想要什么，是因为它们专注于「利用」（exploitation）——也就是不断强化那些已经证明有效的选项。这对商业有利，对消费者有时也是必要的，因为现代生活中的选择实在太多。没有 AI 帮忙筛选，我们几乎无法应对现代生活的复杂性。AI...

articles.title: Evaluating the Evaluation of Music Generation Models with Generative Psychometrics
articles.author: Jo\~ao Carlos Santana Silveira; Caio Von Rondow Morais; Frederico Pedrosa; Lucas N. Ferreira
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.21809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Subjective user studies are one of the major methods for evaluating music generation models. However, subjective evaluation protocols vary widely and are rarely specified in enough detail to be reproduced, hindering comparison across studies. In this paper, we map subjective evaluation methods in ISMIR music generation papers from 2020-2025 and apply generative psychometrics to assess the stability of their items. We extract 284 items from the papers' methodological descriptions, using an LLM and manual validation to standardize them. We represent these items as contextual embeddings and apply Unique Variable Analysis to remove redundant, locally dependent items and Bootstrap Exploratory Graph Analysis to estimate their latent dimensions....

articles.title: High-Fidelity Binarized Neural Vocoder
articles.author: Andong Li; Tong Lei; Xiaodong Li; Chengshi Zheng
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.22593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural vocoders have achieved remarkable progress in high-fidelity waveform generation in recent years, but most existing methods still rely on full-precision operators, leading to non-negligible storage and computational costs during inference. Binary neural networks (BNNs) provide an alternative direction by quantizing weights and activations to 1 bit. However, directly applying binarization to neural vocoders is rather challenging as it inherently incurs severe information loss. To this end, we propose BiVoC, a BNN-oriented time-frequency neural vocoder for high-fidelity waveform generation. Building on our previous full-precision RNDVoC framework, BiVoC adapts the inverse-problem formulation, range-null decomposition, and fineto-coarse...

articles.title: Beyond Mimicry: Constrained Exploration with GRPO for Joint Multi-Talker ASR and Diarization under Unknown Speaker Counts
articles.author: Yunrui Cai; Dingdong Wang; Lingwei Meng; Xixin Wu; Zhiyong Wu; Helen Meng
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.22627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Joint multi-talker ASR with speaker attribution and timestamps is particularly challenging when the speaker count is unknown and the output must follow a strict structure. We observe that Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)-only alignment of SpeechLLMs is brittle under dense overlaps, often leading to burst hallucinations and malformed speaker/timestamp tags. We propose a unified two-stage generative framework: (i) CoT-augmented SFT that infers the global speaker count before transcription, and (ii) GRPO-based constrained exploration guided by a Multi-dimensional Constraint-Aware Reward (MCAR) that directly optimizes permutation-invariant accuracy while enforcing counting, temporal, and structural constraints. articles.title: Sleep2Word: Peripheral-to-EEG Translation via Duration-Aware Wordization
articles.author: Keondo Park; Arthur Delhaye; Younghoon Na; Hyun-Woo Shin; Hyung-Sin Kim
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.21643v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Estimating full-night electroencephalography (EEG) spectrograms from peripheral measurements could extend EEG-informed sleep analysis to recordings acquired without EEG. This task requires compact representations of signals with different temporal structures. We introduce Sleep2Word, a framework for translating respiration, electrocardiography (ECG), or photoplethysmography (PPG) into EEG spectrograms through duration-aware physiological words. Building on context-dependent chunking, Sleep2Word groups physiological embeddings into variable-duration chunks and jointly quantizes their content and duration into modality-specific wordbooks. A block-autoregressive translator then predicts target EEG word identities and occurrence-specific...

articles.title: Structure Across Voices: Comparing acoustic-event type accumulation and sequence dependence across four vocal corpora using frozen audio encoders
articles.author: Mudit Sinha; Sanika Chavan
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.16612v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Comparing acoustic structure across very different vocal corpora is difficult because the recordings use different native event units, contain different amounts of sequence, and were collected under different conditions. We use the high-dimensional representations of frozen, pretrained audio encoders to measure acoustic diversity and temporal organization. Matched sampling gives each corpus the same opportunities to observe new acoustic forms and relationships between events, without changing its native event definition. We compare sperm-whale codas, human speech phones, Bengalese-finch syllables, and common-marmoset calls using 1,952 events and 1,700 adjacent pairs per comparison. Whale shows the fastest accumulation of encoder-defined...

articles.title: Music of the Deep: An acoustic blueprint of sperm whale codas
articles.author: Mudit Sinha; Sanika Chavan
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.33974v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Sperm-whale codas are usually described by click count and spacing. Earlier work found additional structure in click waveforms and across coda sequences. We ask how these two levels compare with performed music. We examine 1,952 codas alongside violin performances, drum grooves, and sung melodies. Using frozen audio encoders, we describe constituent sounds and complete units separately, comparing composition, order, and sequence context. In codas, click composition improves prediction of whole-coda acoustic form beyond timing. Click-form order carries additional conditional information, and rearranging click spacing changes the acoustic representations across six encoders. articles.title: ASR-Protected Fusion and Reference-Anchored Policy Optimization for Joint ASR and Word-Level Speech Anti-Spoofing
articles.author: Xueping Zhang; Xiaoxiao Miao; Tiantian Feng; Ming Li
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.34156v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Existing anti-spoofing systems report either an utterance-level score or a time-based spoof interval: the former cannot show which words are spoofed, while the latter does not directly match the transcript and must be post-aligned with words, so alignment errors can lead to wrong word-level labels. Standard ASR model outputs only text; spoof information in the audio is lost after recognition and is not passed with the transcript. Yet changing only a few words can change the meaning of a sentence, leaving downstream systems to use incorrect text without knowing which words are spoofed. articles.title: Score-Informed Transformer for Refining MIDI Velocity in Automatic Piano Transcription
articles.author: Zhanhong He (David); Roberto Togneri (David); Defeng (David); Huang
articles.summary: arXiv:2508.07757v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: MIDI velocity is crucial for capturing expressive dynamics in human performances. In practical scenarios, a music score with inaccurate velocities may be available alongside the performance audio (e.g., music education and free online archives), enabling the task of score-informed MIDI velocity estimation. In this work, we propose a modular, lightweight score-informed Transformer correction module that refines the velocity estimates of Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) systems. Leveraging high-quality expressive datasets for rigorous evaluation, we focus on piano transcription, integrating our module into multiple existing systems. articles.title: AutoMV: An Automatic Multi-Agent System for Music Video Generation

articles.summary: arXiv:2512.12196v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Turning a full song into a music video (MV) requires interpreting its lyrics, which are often metaphorical, multilingual, and repeated across choruses, together with its musical character, and laying the resulting imagery out along the song's structure. articles.summary: arXiv:2606.01264v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a multimodal dataset of 1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio from three healthy native Japanese speakers during open-vocabulary overt speech, covert repetition and speech listening. Each session provides time-synchronized EEG, facial EMG, and audio, together with speech-event annotations and transcriptions. Although collected with speech decoding as a primary motivation, the dataset also supports work on multimodal signal processing,...

articles.author: Wensi Zhang; Tomas Teijeiro; J\'er\^ome Thevenot; David Atienza
articles.summary: arXiv:2608.25846v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Cough acoustics are promising for non-invasive tuberculosis (TB) screening, yet whether machine learning (ML) models capture disease-related acoustics or artifacts of data collection remains unresolved. We evaluated the cross-dataset generalizability of classical ML and deep learning (DL) cough-based TB classifiers across three independent datasets. articles.title: Who Says What: Symbolic Trimodal Binding Mechanisms in Audio-Visual LLMs
articles.author: Jihoo Jung; Youngjoon Jang; Joon Son Chung
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.31193v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Current Audio-Visual LLMs (AVLLMs) struggle with reasoning over videos featuring multi-speaker dialogues. In such videos, resolving "who says what" is crucial, which necessitates trimodal (text-audio-visual) binding. Motivated by these challenges, we systematically investigate how this trimodal binding is achieved in AVLLMs. Specifically, we identify emergent symbolic trimodal binding mechanisms in AVLLMs that utilize modality-specific symbolic variables. By encoding auditory and visual components into symbolic variables-capturing temporal utterance sequences and spatial entity coordinates, respectively-the model establishes cross-modal linking within this abstract space. Crucially, we reveal that when trimodal binding fails, the...

articles.title: Auditing Hyperstimulation at Scale in Child-Facing YouTube Videos
articles.author: Shao-Yu Chu; Noel Mekogue; Qiyu Li; Xuan Liu; Shuang Hao; Haojian Jin
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.21637v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Parents, pediatricians, and journalists have raised concern that child-facing videos are becoming increasingly overstimulating, but this concern rests mostly on ad hoc observation rather than systematic measurement. We present a large-scale audit of hyperstimulation patterns, which we refer to as content-independent production choices that may exceed young children's capacity to process comfortably. Drawing on parents' Reddit discussions and developmental psychology, we identify 12 hyperstimulation patterns and operationalize them as computational metrics. We apply these metrics to 16,375 videos from 542 child-facing YouTube channels spanning 2015-2026. We found broad increases in stimulation over time, with cut rates rising across all...

articles.title: LeViT-UNet++: Towards Balanced Fine-Grained Details and Context for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
articles.author: Guoping Xu; Jinling Zhu; Liuyue Li
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.22482v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Efficient medical image segmentation is essential for clinical applications requiring fast and accurate delineation, such as surgical navigation, radiation therapy, and real-time image-guided intervention. Despite substantial advances in convolutional neural networks and Transformers, attaining high accuracy under limited computational resources remains difficult, because reducing model complexity often sacrifices fine-grained structural details and global context modeling, yielding an unfavorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. To address this, we propose LeViT-UNet++, an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that better balances local detail preservation and global context modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale...

articles.summary: arXiv:2512.12196v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Turning a full song into a music video (MV) requires interpreting its lyrics, which are often metaphorical, multilingual, and repeated across choruses, together with its musical character, and laying the resulting imagery out along the song's structure. articles.title: DAT: Dual-Aware Adaptive Transmission with Small-Large Model Collaboration for Edge-Cloud Anomaly Detection
articles.author: Qi Guo; Zheming Yang; Yunqing Hu; Chang Zhao; Wen Ji
articles.summary: arXiv:2604.05375v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Continuous video anomaly detection is critical for timely safety monitoring in edge--cloud visual systems, but it remains challenging because abnormal events are sparse, transient, and require both low-latency anomaly detection and verifiable visual evidence. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and visual reasoning capabilities for such event-centric analysis, yet applying them to continuous video streams incurs prohibitive computation and communication overhead under bandwidth-constrained edge--cloud deployments. To address this challenge, we propose DAT, a dual-aware adaptive transmission framework that supports high-quality semantic generation, low-latency anomaly detection, and progressive...

articles.title: Cassette-Editor: Shared Timeline Semantics for Human and Agent Editing
articles.author: Zhixin Zeng; Jiahao Zhong
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.37690v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Video editing involves tedious manual manipulation across interconnected timeline tracks, motivating automated agents that offload routine work while keeping the project directly revisable by humans. Fixed operation catalogs limit expressiveness, while even a basic trim requires coordinated updates across later clips, attached titles, and transitions. We present Cassette-Editor, an agent harness that unifies manual user gestures and automated agent patches within a shared editing environment. The shared action language expresses the editor's manual content changes, and a common history records committed edits for undo and manual refinement. When the model selects an edit, a state executor automatically derives its downstream...

articles.title: Human-Data Interaction, Exploration, and Visualization Systems in the AI Era: Challenges and Opportunities
articles.author: Jean-Daniel Fekete; Yifan Hu; Dominik Moritz; Arnab Nandi; Senjuti Basu Roy; Eugene Wu; Nikos Bikakis; George Papastefanatos; Panos K. Chrysanthis; Guoliang Li; Lingyun Yu
articles.summary: arXiv:2603.05542v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The rapid advancement of AI is transforming human-centered systems, with profound implications for human-AI interaction, human-data interaction, and visual analytics. In the AI era, data analysis increasingly involves large-scale, heterogeneous, and multimodal data that is predominantly unstructured, as well as foundation models such as LLMs and VLMs, which introduce additional uncertainty into analytical processes. These shifts expose persistent challenges for human-data interactive systems, including perceptually misaligned latency, scalability constraints, limitations of existing interaction and exploration paradigms, and growing uncertainty regarding the reliability and interpretability of AI-generated insights. articles.title: Relation-Aware Evidence Routing and Confidence-Guided Adaptation for Zero-Shot Visual Anomaly Detection
articles.author: Xinyu Zhao; Yang Hu; Jiayi Luo; Qingyun Sun; Jianxin Li
articles.summary: arXiv:2605.28630v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Zero-shot visual anomaly detection (ZSAD) aims to identify and localize anomalies in unseen categories without target-domain adaptation, yet heterogeneous anomaly patterns and cross-domain variations challenge reliable detection. Existing approaches primarily rely on local visual features, patch-text similarities, or memory-based retrieval, leaving inter-patch relational information underexplored in anomaly evidence modeling. In this paper, we propose RACE-AD, a relation-aware evidence routing and confidence-guided adaptation framework that integrates local anomaly responses with attention-derived relational information for generalizable ZSAD. To capture inter-patch relationships, we characterize the dispersion of visual attention...

articles.title: Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning
articles.author: Qiangchang Wang; Chong Xiao; Xiaokun Bai; Rundong He; Zhuang Qi; Xusheng Liang; Zhibin Wu; Wenhao Li
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.20349v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. articles.title: Personalized Causal Low-Bitrate Coded Speech Restoration with Speaker Embeddings
articles.author: Eray \"Ozg\"unay, Christian Rollwage, Kishan Gupta, Andreas Brendel, Xavier Domont, Mattes Ohlenbusch, Jan Rennies, Simon Doclo
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.22620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Legacy low-bitrate speech codecs such as AMR-NB remain widely used in telephony, where they restrict speech bandwidth and degrade listening quality. Coded speech restoration (CSR) aims to restore the speech bandwidth while improving the overall quality of coded speech, but typically without adapting to different speakers. In this paper, we systematically investigate personalization for restoration of speech coded at low bitrates, using a causal, low-complexity Universal Bandwidth Extension Generative Adversarial Network (UBGAN) model as the basis. We propose two personalization methods based on speaker embeddings, which incur little additional computational cost at inference: (i) conditioning a single CSR model on speaker embeddings, and...

articles.title: Sleep2Word: Peripheral-to-EEG Translation via Duration-Aware Wordization
articles.author: Keondo Park; Arthur Delhaye; Younghoon Na; Hyun-Woo Shin; Hyung-Sin Kim
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.21643v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Estimating full-night electroencephalography (EEG) spectrograms from peripheral measurements could extend EEG-informed sleep analysis to recordings acquired without EEG. This task requires compact representations of signals with different temporal structures. We introduce Sleep2Word, a framework for translating respiration, electrocardiography (ECG), or photoplethysmography (PPG) into EEG spectrograms through duration-aware physiological words. Building on context-dependent chunking, Sleep2Word groups physiological embeddings into variable-duration chunks and jointly quantizes their content and duration into modality-specific wordbooks. A block-autoregressive translator then predicts target EEG word identities and occurrence-specific...

articles.title: Score-Informed Transformer for Refining MIDI Velocity in Automatic Piano Transcription
articles.author: Zhanhong He (David); Roberto Togneri (David); Defeng (David); Huang
articles.summary: arXiv:2508.07757v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: MIDI velocity is crucial for capturing expressive dynamics in human performances. In practical scenarios, a music score with inaccurate velocities may be available alongside the performance audio (e.g., music education and free online archives), enabling the task of score-informed MIDI velocity estimation. In this work, we propose a modular, lightweight score-informed Transformer correction module that refines the velocity estimates of Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) systems. Leveraging high-quality expressive datasets for rigorous evaluation, we focus on piano transcription, integrating our module into multiple existing systems. Trained exclusively on the MAESTRO dataset, our method consistently reduces velocity errors and improves...

articles.title: Agent多人共用为何会失控？来自Ankole的Business Agent架构设计分享
articles.summary: 机器之心 2026-11-18 13:00 北京 它面向整个组织运行，支持多角色成员与多个专职 Agent 在同一套数据、权限与责任边界上协同工作 机器之心发布继 Coding Agent 之后，Muse、Grok Bot 等 Personal Agent 产品也快速成熟。不少团队尝试把它们引入组织：要么给每位成员部署一套，要么把同一个 Agent 接进部门群聊。但单人使用表现稳定的 Agent，一旦放到多人协同场景总是表现得非常不及预期。这是因为用户在使用 Agent 时实际上人肉承担了多项外围工作：手动布置任务、间歇性观察执行过程、分享本机文件与账号凭证。而在进入组织环境后，这种人机协同的 Loop 便会在四个方面失效：认知分叉：每位成员的 Personal Agent 各自维护私有上下文。某个群里刚更新的业务规则，不会同步给其他成员的 Agent，团队很快会按不同的标准各自行事。上下文窗口泄密：单人 Agent 默认凡是能读到的信息都可用于回答。把绑定高权限接口的 Agent 放进多人群聊后，它无法区分仅供它自己看的信息与在场所有人都有权看的信息。状态分裂：缺少共用的结构化存储，成员与各自的 Agent 只能靠互传文件副本同步数据，多人并发修改很快产生多份冲突版本。轮询的算力税与误差复利：靠每隔几分钟唤醒模型来执行自动化任务，在数百条业务流并行的团队里会让大量 Token 空耗在不必要的环境。并且执行结果的概率误差还会随着调用轮次累积：即便单次判断准确率达到 99%，每 5 分钟检查一次、全天运行 288 轮，一天内至少出错一次的概率也会高达 1-0.99^288≈94.5%如果说 Coding Agent 面向单次开发任务，Personal Agent 面向个人跨会话事务，那么进入企业则需要第三类形态：Business...

articles.title: openJiuwen首发AgentOS「Harnessless」开发范式：不用自建Harness，让Agent原生应用触手可及
articles.summary: 机器之心 2026-11-18 13:00 北京 openJiuwen AgentOS，从应用开发到统一管理！ 机器之心发布开发一个新应用时，能不能直接用上 Agent，让它读取业务状态、调用工具，甚至和其他 Agent 一起完成任务？openJiuwen 在《HyperAgent 架构解读》中谈到了 Agent 如何通过扩展机制获得新能力。今天，openJiuwen 将这一思路延伸到应用开发，依托 openJiuwen AgentOS 推出 Harnessless 开发范式。开发者可以直接复用平台已有的 Agent 能力，将它们接入自己的软件，让 Agent 参与实际的业务流程。应用市场是我们熟悉的软件入口。发现应用、下载使用、统一管理，我们已经习惯通过这样的方式，让手机和电脑拥有新的功能。如今，不少软件的 AI 体验像是把聊天窗口缝在旧流程旁边。助手能给出建议，但是用户还要把答案搬回业务页面，亲手完成后续操作。对话增加了一步，原来的工作一步也没少。openJiuwen 率先发力 Agent 原生应用，让 Agent 直接参与软件的业务流程。用户提出目标，Agent 读取应用的业务状态、调用工具并推进任务，执行结果直接回到原来的界面。复杂工作还可以由多个 Agent 分工完成。开发这样的应用，接入模型只是起点。要让 Agent 进入业务流程，开发者还得处理上下文、工具权限、任务执行和多 Agent 协作。这些机制合在一起，就是 Agent 的 Harness。如果每个应用都要重做一遍，开发一个业务功能就可能变成搭建一套 Agent 基础设施。openJiuwen 希望把这部分工作承接下来。Harnessless：开发 Agent 原生应用，直接使用已有的 Agent 能力这里的 Harnessless，指的是应用开发者不必自行实现 Harness，而是直接使用...

articles.title: 即梦 Seedance 2.5 大升级，AI 视频生成终于有了自己的 4K 生产线
articles.author: 山宗
articles.summary: 影像江湖的金字塔尖，永远有大银幕的一席之地。 所以判断一门影像手艺成没成，有个简单粗暴的试金石：敢不敢上大银幕。胶片当年闯过这关，数字摄影机也闯过，三维动画同样闯过，每闯过一关，就意味着一项新技术拿到了成熟影像工业的入场券。 过去两年，AI 视频生成你方唱罢我登场，一个比一个惊艳，可真正到了商业制作的修罗场，甲方要的是原生 4K，导演想一镜到底，品牌方动不动就改需求，制作团队还得在成本、周期和最终交付之间走钢丝。 最近，爱范儿注意到即梦 Seedance 2.5 推出了 4K 版本，把最长 30 秒单次生成、全模态参考、视频编辑与延长等本领一并拉到了更高的画质规格。 AI 视频的成人礼，就该从拥有一条 4K 生产线开始。 甲方的显微镜下，AI 视频迎来 4K 大考 过去体验 AI 视频模型，我总习惯给它安排一些足够热闹的场面。巨型怪兽、千军万马、末日都市，最好再来点爆炸与运镜，十几秒的视频也能拍出大片预告的气势。 但仔细想想，真正让商业制作团队头疼的，可能是一瓶香水上的标签、一张在不同渠道反复使用的商品图，或者导演临时要求修改的某个镜头。 因此，在体验 Seedance 2.5 4K 时，我更想把它放进四种具体的商业场景，看看画质升级究竟能改变多少实际工作。 品牌 TVC，藏在产品特写里的交付标准 假设客户要拍一条高端机械腕表广告，镜头从表盘的极近距离开始，掠过钻石时标和日期窗口，最后缓缓后退，露出放在私人书房里的完整腕表。 整条片子没有激烈动作，难处却都藏在细节里。金属表圈的切面、表盘的太阳纹、随着机位移动的反光，以及日期窗口里的数字，都需要保持清晰、准确和连续。 对于一条需要交付 4K 的品牌 TVC，直接生成 4K 意味着可以省去后期超分的工序，避免二次放大可能引入的画质问题。 而且，画质升级还不止于分辨率。Seedance 2.5 的 4K 模式支持 10bit...

articles.title: OpenAI 联创和首席研究员共同发声：RSI 真的要来了吗？
articles.summary: 深思圈 2026-11-18 11:46 浙江 OpenAI 首席研究官 Mark Chen 说，AI 研究实习生已经造出来了，AI 自我改进大概走了 25% 到 50%。联合创始人 John Schulman 把一个想法交给 AI 干了几天，结果没成，人一上手才走得远。AI 能自己判断 你有没有想过，AI 实验室里干活的那些研究员，现在手底下已经有了一批不睡觉的实习生？这些实习生不是人，是 AI。它们帮研究员跑实验、盯实验、写代码，研究员只管给方向。这是 a16z 新开的节目 Working Theory 第一期聊的话题。a16z 普通合伙人 Sarah Wang 请来了两位嘉宾：OpenAI 首席研究官 Mark Chen，在 OpenAI 八年多，从 2025 年起和 Jakub Pachocki 一起负责整个研究团队；还有 OpenAI 联合创始人 John Schulman，ChatGPT 最主要的设计者之一，现在是 Thinking Machines Lab 的联合创始人和首席科学家。聊的题目叫 RSI，全称 recursive self-improvement（递归自我改进），意思是让 AI 帮着把下一代 AI 做得更强。这个概念存在很多年了，一直只是个思想实验，现在前沿实验室开始把它做成真的东西。节目只有 16 分钟，但两个人说的几件事，我觉得值得拆开讲讲。RSI 在 OpenAI 眼里，先是一个加速器RSI 这个词很容易让人想到科幻电影：AI 自己造出更强的 AI，一代接一代，直到人类跟不上。Mark 和 John 谈的却是更朴素的版本。John 说，造一个能发布的模型，主线是一条很长的训练流程，从预训练到后训练再到跑评测，每个环节都有很多人。同时旁边还有各种探索性的研究，先跑一些小实验，验证想法，给大训练做准备。在他看来，RSI 就是用 AI...

articles.summary: Parallel 开源搜索评测框架：模型接入搜索后，到底强了多少？给模型接上搜索，不等于它就能把研究任务做好。还需要判断何时搜索、如何提问、哪些网页值得继续读取，以及证据是否够支撑答案。 @p0 开源 parallel-search-evals，就是把这条链路放进可重复运行的评测中，衡量搜索对最终答案的帮助，以及为此付出的成本。# 不只测搜索结果，更测模型能否用好搜索核心方法：让同一个模型分别在关闭工具、允许搜索的条件下答题，再比较结果。每次运行固定一个模型、一套题目和一种搜索模式，支持 turbo、fast、basic、advanced，也支持不使用工具的基线。模型可以调用两个工具：Search 根据自然语言目标和关键词，返回最多 10 条附带正文摘录的结果；Extract 从最多 20 个指定网址提取内容。每题最多执行 20 次工具调用、进行 25 轮研究，预算用尽后再关闭工具，让模型给出最终答案。参考答案只交给评分器，不进入答题过程。因此，它衡量的不只是搜索接口的质量，是「模型选择工具、获取证据、形成答案」的整体能力。# 可以换上自己的业务问题项目采用 MIT 许可，支持 OpenRouter，以及 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 的原生接口，也能接入兼容 OpenAI 的服务。更重要的是，题目集、Agent 执行流程和评分器相互分离。开发者可以替换问题、参考答案和评分规则，在统一预算下测试自己的业务。仓库还附带供 Claude Code、Codex 使用的技能说明，帮助完成运行、续跑和结果整理。目前内置 DeepSearchQA 和 Humanity’s Last Exam 的纯文本题，数据需按各自条款准备。评分使用 GPT-6 Sol：前者允许部分得分，后者按严格对错判断。# 最高分和最低成本，未必来自同一个模型Parallel...

articles.summary: Z Potentials 2026-11-18 10:41 北京 “AI下一阶段的发展核心在于深度落地复杂商业场景，充分释放下一代商业智能体的价值。” 近日，总部位于硅谷的Aimotion 宣布，知名AI科学家李沐出任公司联合创始人兼CTO，主导下一代产业级AI技术体系建设。李沐将继续担任Boson AI联合创始人兼CTO，双方将联合攻关产业级世界模型与商业AI Agent技术。李沐为Apache MXNet创始人之一、前AWS AI资深首席科学家、卡内基梅隆计算机博士。他表示，AI下一阶段的发展核心在于深度落地复杂商业场景，充分释放下一代商业智能体的价值。据Z Potentials了解，Aimotion已于近期完成由BAI Capital领投的A轮数千万美元融资。Aimotion扎根汽车等高价值、长决策周期行业，提供AI销售营销解决方案，业务覆盖美洲、欧洲、亚太等市场。此次合作将融合Boson AI底层模型能力与Aimotion真实产业场景沉淀，打通基础技术与产业应用闭环，打造面向商业环境的产业级世界模型。区别于通用仿真类世界模型，该技术将对商业规则、客户决策逻辑、业务因果关系进行建模，实现场景推演、趋势预判与长周期任务规划，赋能AI Agent从被动问答升级为可自主执行复杂销售业务的智能主体，推动AI由营销辅助工具转变为创造实际收益的商业智能系统。随着企业级AI迈向深水区，单纯依靠通用大模型的对话交互已难以满足复杂商业决策的需求，“产业级世界模型+垂直商业Agent”的范式融合，正成为驱动B端生产力实质性跃迁的新方向。Aimotion透露，后续将择机公布技术与产品最新进展。 跳转微信打开

articles.summary: OpenAI 可能没想到，自己精心准备的新模型，刚刚发布就迎来了一场颇为热闹的舆论风波。 今天凌晨，OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol，主打更强的专业工作能力、更高的 Token 效率，以及进一步降低的使用成本。 按照官方公布的成绩，新模型在编程、科研、专业办公、3D 设计等领域表现出色，部分任务的完成成本甚至降至上一代的三分之一以下。 而在首批开发者实测中，GPT-6.2 的评价却出现了明显分化。有人惊叹于它的 3D 生成能力和成本优势，也有人认为模型在复杂任务中表现糟糕，甚至专门写了一封长信向 OpenAI 投诉。 我们也那么 GPT-6.2 究竟表现如何？ GPT-6.2 登场，跑分更聪明、更便宜 此次发布的两款模型有着不同定位，其中 GPT-6.2 Astra 面向复杂专业任务，GPT-6.2 Sol 则更加注重效率与成本，覆盖日常办公、编程及多步骤 Agent 工作。 在衡量长周期、多步骤专业任务的 Agents’ Last Exam 测试中，GPT-6.2 Astra 比上一代高出 5.2 分，完成任务的成本却不到后者的三分之一；与 Claude Fable 5.2 相比，它领先 5.5 分，任务成本仅为对方的 5%。 科研能力同样获得提升。在 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 测试中，Astra 的成绩比上一代提高 9 个百分点，OpenAI 甚至宣称，这是目前最适合科学家的模型。 第三方评测机构 Artificial Analysis 的结果也提供了一个参照，GPT-6.2 Astra 在综合智能指数中排名第二，仅次于 Claude Fable 5.2，但在 Coding Agent 指数中与上一代持平，GPT-6.2 Sol 反而下降了 3 分。 相比单纯刷新...

articles.summary: Tobi Lütke 在 Vercel Ship 谈「第三类顾客」：Agent 代购是增量，工程变成核验Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke 与 Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch，在旧金山 Vercel Ship SF 做了这场约半小时的炉边对谈「The Third Customer」：youtube.com/watch?v=p7AhQO…Agent 购物是增量，不是把店面全部替换掉官方回顾把「第三类顾客」概括为：为会替人检索、比较并下单的 Agent 做商业。自动字幕里，台上并未逐字解释这个标题。Lütke 说，这件事已经很真实，却仍很早；他不认为 Agent 会取代全部交易，并随口估计，人们把采购交给 Agent 的部分或许会占到两到五成，同时也可能再增加约五成新需求。他更看重「项目式购物」：布置万圣节、带孩子做 3D 打印，由 Agent 在周末前备齐材料，很多人本不会完成这类消费。有辨识度的精品店体验仍有空间，难做的是没有特色的百货和同质化市场。把目录和结账做成可调用的能力Rauch 说，当天已把 Vercel Shop 作为面向 Shopify 的开源 Next.js 店面模板正式推出。Vercel 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日公开的博文，也写明该模板与跨框架的 Hydrogen SDK 已一般可用。谈到 Universal Commerce Protocol 时，Lütke 说结账极难做对，需要长期打磨，也仍要有规模不小的常设工程团队，因为合规要求在变。他认为，把这些麻烦做成可调用的接口，并允许别人复用结账部件，才是对开放网络的贡献。他特别提醒不要忽视目录 API：不必先同时拉起买卖双方，就可以做发现和策展。目前覆盖的是 Shopify 商品；他说以后会扩展到全网商品。工程师的工作变成核验谈到内部工程，他呼应 DHH...

articles.summary: 白鲸出海 2026-11-18 10:16 四川 去年，Hank Green 打造的「Focus Friend」爆火，一度登顶美国 iOS 下载总榜。国内也涌现由独立开发者打造、玩法多样的专注类应用。（详见往期文章《“Nerd之王”做的App，不到一个月登顶美国总榜》）今年，又出现一款由 YC 孵化的“另类”专注应用「Island」，乍一看玩法和画风上都像是模拟经营类游戏，然而其实际功能却是促使用户专注。据「Island」数据显示，官方称产品用户活跃度表现良好，DAU/MAU 为 51%，30 天后用户留存为 49%。一、专注 App 下的“经营游戏”逻辑「Island」采用像素画风，用户拥有自己的小岛农场，设置每日屏幕使用时间，未超标即可获得“信用分”，用于提升农场作物产量、解锁更多农作物和动物。App 不强锁应用或切断使用，靠用户自律和“想看岛屿繁荣”驱动专注。用户种植作物后，可卖出果实、动物，换取金币。货船会在用户设置的时间点，准时出现，提供每日交易机会。错过则再等一天。换取的金币可以购买更多作物种子和畜禽。二、社交玩法下，“命运绑定”此外，「Island」还设置了社交玩法，可加好友互访岛屿、绑一位朋友“共岛”，任一方超过屏幕使用限时，两座岛的经营会一起受损。商业化方面，「Island」目前免费，但如果想要设置不同 App 的使用限时，需要支付约 40 美元的年度订阅费。 跳转微信打开

articles.summary: OpenAI 终于发布 GPT-6.2：Astra 挑战专业难题，Sol 降低日常任务成本，这两个模型能让 OpenAI 重新站起来吗？这段时间被 Fable 5.2 和 Opus 5.5 要打趴下了。。。OpenAI 今天同时推出 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol：前者面向高难度专业项目，后者面向日常工作与多步 Agent 流程。重点不再只是能力提高，而要用更少的输出 token 完成任务。这次先进入 ChatGPT Work、Codex 和 API，并未加入普通 Chat。openai.com/index/introduc…两个型号，如何分工？Astra 重点提升文档、表格、幻灯片、编程和计算机操作能力，也强调科研、CAD 与仿真等复杂任务。Sol 则主打效率，希望以更低成本承担更多日常工作。两者都支持文本和图像输入、文本输出，上下文窗口均为 105 万 token。API 标准价方面，Astra 每百万 token 输入 8 美元、输出 40 美元，均比 GPT-6 Astra 低 20%；Sol 输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，与 GPT-6.1 Sol 持平。单价只是成本的一部分，实际账单还取决于任务消耗多少推理与输出 token。提升体现在哪里在考察长程专业工作流的 Agents’ Last Exam 上，Astra 比 GPT-6 Astra 高 5.2 分，成本不到三分之一；内部 GDPval v2 专业工作评测中，提高 6.2 个百分点，输出 token 减少 22%。这说明官方强调的是交付质量与计算开销一起改善，而不只是分数。Sol 更值得注意的结果来自真实代码库修改评测 FrontierCode 2.0：两者均使用最高推理档位时，Sol 与 Astra 只差 0.5 分，成本约为五分之一。但这不代表它在所有任务上都接近...

articles.summary: Auto-translated posts on X are such gems. articles.summary: 原创 Ye_susu 2026-11-18 09:31 北京 ✅ AI+UI设计工作流 👋Hello，这里是Clip设计夹，今天分享的是「AI设计提效」，文章来自设计师Ye_susu的工作思考。秉持着提升工作效率的目的，最近我一直在研究使用agent生成设计稿。虽然结果不甚理想，但也确实可以省去部分工作。以下是个人实践中的一些心理路程，希望能为大家提供参考。01 搭建页面框架说起提升效率，我首先想到的是：虽然agent生成的视觉效果未必靠谱，但若能利用组件库搭建起页面框架，我在此基础上再进行调整也算是省下了不少事。于是我进行了第一次尝试，虽然figma agent可以指定组件库生成设计稿，但最终的效果还是差强人意：组件用法错误、更擅自更改组件名称、分离组件、未使用文本样式和变量……各种问题层出不穷。我本想着在网上找找相关skill来约束下生成结果，但遗憾的是没有找到合适的方案，于是只能自己动手，丰衣足食。有了agent的加持，编写skill其实并不困难。只要将整理好的诉求丢给它，便能得到一份还不错的初稿。接下来需要不断优化和测试，关于优化需要注意流程是否合理、内容是否简练、表达是否自然，关于测试则需要关注模型版本、上下文及agent能力边界。经过一系列调整，agent终于能够严格按照组件库搭建设计稿。skill: design-system-use (后台回复skill获取链接)解决组件库的问题后，我又想到两个可以提升效率的方向：文本翻译和页面命名。因为我们做的是海外项目，设计稿需要使用英文文本。过去的工作方式是一边搭建页面框架，一边进行翻译；现在可以将翻译流程加入skill，让agent直接输出英文稿。至于页面命名，过去需要手动复制交互页面名称，再逐一粘贴；现在也可以将这步写入skill，让agent一并完成。最后，我还希望 agent...

articles.title: 推理提速5倍，腾讯 HiGR 详解
articles.summary: 原创 NLPer 2026-11-18 09:26 江苏 生成式推荐的三道关 刚刚结束的 CIKM 2026 大会，腾讯 TRS 团队推出了一套列表级生成式推荐框架 HiGR，把用户一次看到的整组内容交给模型规划和生成。这项工作，已经在腾讯资讯、视频、网文等多个场景上线，服务数亿用户。HiGR 属于TGR 系列模型之一。TGR（Tencent Generative Recommendation）是腾讯 PCG 打造的一体化生成式推荐技术解决方案，已经集成到 TRS 推荐引擎平台：https://trs.tencent.com。TGR 以生成式范式重塑推荐系统，涵盖统一语义 ID、生成式排序、端到端生成、大模型推理增强与推荐系统递归自我改进等方向。目前，TGR 已在腾讯新闻、视频、网络小说等业务的10多个场景规模化落地，助力观看时长、广告收入与新用户转化等核心指标提升；相关成果已在 AAAI、ACL、CIKM 等国际顶级会议发表多篇论文。HiGR 聚焦的是这些业务中的列表推荐（Slate Recommendation）。在视频流、资讯流、小说推荐里，用户一次看到的往往是一组按顺序排好的内容。推荐得好不好，不只看每一条准不准，还要看谁排前面、内容之间能不能搭配，以及会不会过于相似。工业界常见的做法，仍然是先给候选内容逐条打分，再通过规则或重排拼成列表。每条单独看都值得推荐，放在一起却未必合适：几条高度相似的内容挤在一屏里，单条相关性很高，整组的体验仍可能不好。HiGR 把列表的组织提前到了生成过程中：模型结合用户兴趣和前面已选的内容，规划下一个位置，再生成对应物品的 ID。它再通过列表级偏好训练，把排序、兴趣匹配和多样性一起纳入优化。生成式推荐的三道关要直接生成推荐，得先把内容库中的物品变成模型能够生成的表示。生成式推荐用语义 ID（SID）把物品编码成一串离散...

articles.summary: 辞去英伟达 CEO 职务仅仅五天后，黄仁勋终于公开发声，回应了外界持续发酵的回归呼声。 上下滑动查看更多内容 今天凌晨，黄仁勋在个人 X 账号发表长文，感谢过去一周来自朋友、行业同事，以及英伟达员工和投资者的支持。他再次承认自己在个人生活中犯下错误，同时首次明确表示，愿意重新担任英伟达 CEO。 然而，就在黄仁勋公开表达回归意愿的几个小时后，英伟达董事会给出了截然相反的答复。 在最新季度财报电话会议上，英伟达董事长 Harvey Jones 明确表示，董事会已经一致接受黄仁勋的辞呈，目前无意恢复他的 CEO 职务。 图｜Harvey Jones，来源 AnalyticsInsight 同一天，英伟达还交出了一份相当亮眼的财报：季度营收达到 1158 亿美元，同比增长 103%，净利润达到 653 亿美元。 一边是创始人希望重返公司，一边是董事会明确拒绝，而英伟达的 AI 芯片生意仍在高速增长。 这家刚刚经历重大人事变动的科技巨头，似乎已经准备好继续向前走了。 黄仁勋：如果董事会同意，我愿意回来 这是黄仁勋自 11 月 12 日辞去英伟达 CEO 职务以来，首次面向公众发表完整声明。 在文章开头，他首先感谢了过去一周给予自己和家人支持的人。 过去一周，来自朋友、行业同事，以及许多素未谋面的人的关爱和支持，让我深受感动。 随后，黄仁勋回顾了自己的经历。 图｜创业早期的黄仁勋 他提到，自己 53 年前来到美国，能够成为美国公民、创办英伟达，并与无数出色的同事共同将公司建设成今天的模样，是他一生中最大的荣幸之一。 他也没有回避此前引发争议的个人问题。 黄仁勋承认，自己在个人生活中犯下了严重错误，给董事会造成了困扰，对此深感后悔。他表示愿意承担全部责任，并将继续配合董事会正在进行的独立调查。 随后，话锋转向了过去几天持续升温的回归呼声。 图｜The Strait Times...

articles.title: Does a Code-Tuned Embedding Model Pay Off? papr-embed-code-1 in Qdrant
articles.author: info@qdrant.tech (Andrey Vasnetsov)
articles.summary: If you search code, you’ve probably asked this: is a code-specific embedding model worth it, or is a strong general one good enough? Papr’s papr-embed-code-1 is a good test case. It’s Qwen3-Embedding trained further on code retrieval, with open weights in two sizes: 0.6B and 4B. Papr reports top scores on CoIR, a code retrieval benchmark. But it trained on most of CoIR’s training data, and its model card says so. Papr also reports the 4B at #1 on MTEB’s two held-out code leaderboards, RTEB (Code) and CodeRAG.

articles.title: Automating the ADLC with Engine | Introduction to LangSmith (12/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾Every step of the loop so far was done by hand, and that gets slower as tens of traces become thousands. LangSmith Engine automates the ADLC. It clusters your traces into a short list of agent issues and drafts fixes as pull requests against your codebase. For each issue it also writes dataset examples, with assertions about the agent's behavior as reference outputs. Run on the LangSlice project, Engine finds the delivery minimum bug as a single issue, the one that took the whole Monitor stage to track down by hand. It also finds a bug the course hadn't covered, where the agent claims order cancellations it can't perform. Once an issue is marked done, Engine keeps watching and reopens it if new traces show the same failure. Chapters: 0:00 Why manual iteration slows down at scale 0:25...

articles.title: Closing the Loop | Introduction to LangSmith (11/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾In the Monitor stage, five LangSmith features worked together to surface the LangSlice agent's second bug. The confirm_order tool checks the delivery minimum against the sides and ignores the pizzas. This short lesson lays out how that chain fit together and what fixing the bug looks like. Fixing it sends us back to the Test stage. The confirmed threads in the annotation queue and the delivery complaints Insights clustered both push straight to a dataset. From there, a code evaluator that recomputes the order subtotal and a before-and-after experiment show whether the fix holds, while the dashboard and alert keep watching production. Chapters: 0:00 How the Monitor stage features fit together 0:38 Taking the second bug back to the Test stage 1:02 Choosing an evaluator for the fix 1:29...

articles.title: Dashboards and Alerts | Introduction to LangSmith (10/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾Everything we found in the Monitor stage so far came from going looking for it. Dashboards chart how the agent behaves over time, and alerts tell you when a metric crosses a line you set. This lesson starts with the dashboard every LangSmith tracing project comes with, then builds a custom chart of average sentiment from the online evaluator. We finish with an alert that fires when average sentiment drops below 0.8 within a five-minute window, sent to Slack, PagerDuty or a webhook of your own. Chapters: 0:00 Why dashboards and alerts 0:24 The prebuilt tracing project dashboard 1:25 How to build a custom dashboard 1:55 How to set up an alert on feedback scores LangSmith Essentials is a free course on LangChain Academy. LangSmith is LangChain's framework-agnostic platform for agent...

articles.title: Insights | Introduction to LangSmith (9/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾An evaluator answers a question you can write down as a score. Insights is for questions about categories you don't know yet, such as what customers talk about when they're upset. In this lesson we run an Insights report on the LangSlice traces with the auto flow and ask how customers engage with the agent. The report groups conversations into categories, each with the share of traces it covers. The delivery minimum complaints land in one category. The rest show what people order and which requests the agent doesn't support yet. Any category can go straight to a dataset or an annotation queue. Insights needs at least a LangSmith Plus plan. Chapters: 0:00 What we know so far 0:29 When to use Insights instead of an evaluator 1:07 How to create an Insights report 2:09 Reading the executive...

articles.title: Annotation Queues | Introduction to LangSmith (8/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾An LLM judge that has never been checked against human labels can be confidently wrong at scale. In this lesson we label the LangSlice threads in an annotation queue by hand and compare our labels with the sentiment evaluator's. Two customers stayed polite while leaving without what they came for, and the judge scored both as positive. Adding an outcome section to the rubric fixes it. The same review turns up the agent's second bug. The confirm_order tool checks the $25 delivery minimum against the sides only, so an order with $43 of pizza gets rejected. We trace it through the tool calls, then ask LangSmith Chat to find the same problem. Chapters: 0:00 What is an annotation queue 0:50 How to set up instructions and a feedback key 1:26 Labeling threads by hand 1:50 Comparing human labels...

articles.title: Online Evals and Automations | Introduction to LangSmith (7/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾In the Test stage, we only learned customers were upset because the LangSlice staff told us. This lesson starts the Monitor stage by scoring sentiment directly from what customers write, as each conversation comes in. We build an LLM-as-judge evaluator that scores whole threads from their human-AI message pairs, so the judge reads the conversation without the tool calls. An automation then routes every scored thread to an annotation queue for human review. You'll also see when an offline evaluator can run online unchanged, and how LangChain-tuned evaluators like Perceived Error flag conversations where something went wrong. Chapters: 0:00 Monitoring a live agent 1:02 Ways to evaluate production traffic 1:29 Running an offline evaluator online 2:09 LangChain-tuned evaluators and Perceived...

articles.title: Deployments | Introduction to LangSmith (6/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾The dev server we've used so far keeps state in memory and ties each run to the request that started it, which breaks once real customers arrive. A LangSmith deployment stores checkpoints in Postgres and puts runs on a queue, so a run survives a dropped connection. We compare langgraph dev with langgraph up, which runs the full Agent Server locally in Docker, and langgraph deploy, which hands it to LangSmith to host. Then we create a deployment from a GitHub repo. Each deployment gets its own tracing project, and with automatic updates on, every push to the branch ships a new revision. Cloud deployment needs a LangSmith Plus plan, and the rest of the course runs on the free tier. Chapters: 0:00 Finding failures you didn't predict 0:43 Why langgraph dev isn't enough for live traffic 1:32...

articles.title: Experiments | Introduction to LangSmith (5/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾An experiment runs your agent over every example in a dataset and scores the results with your evaluators. In this lesson we run a baseline experiment on the LangSlice pizza agent with the LangSmith SDK and read the evaluator's comments on the orders that let out-of-stock toppings through. Then we add a stock check to add_pizza_to_order and run the experiment again. The comparison view lines the two runs up example by example, so you can confirm the failures flipped to passing and the passing orders stayed that way. The same setup works for comparing two models or two versions of a prompt. Chapters: 0:00 What is an experiment in LangSmith 0:26 What to use experiments for 1:10 Ways to run an experiment 1:49 Running a baseline experiment with the SDK 2:41 Reading experiment results 3:39...

articles.title: Datasets and Offline Evaluations | Introduction to LangSmith (4/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾Forking one run in Studio showed how the out-of-stock bug works, but one run can't tell you how often it happens across all the ways customers ask for a pizza. This lesson starts the Test stage by turning LangSlice traces into a LangSmith dataset and writing an evaluator that checks every topping on an order against the ingredient catalog. You'll use a tree filter to pull every trace that added a pizza, including the correct orders, since those are what catch a regression. We also cover when a code-based evaluator is the right choice over an LLM judge, and the mistakes that make LLM judges unreliable, such as scoring on a 1 to 10 scale. Chapters: 0:00 Why one fixed trace isn't enough 0:47 Offline vs online evaluation 1:28 Deciding what to measure 2:04 What is a dataset in LangSmith 2:55...

articles.title: Debugging with Studio | Introduction to LangSmith (3/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾A trace records a run that already happened, so it can't tell you what the agent would have done if a tool had behaved correctly. LangGraph Studio can. In this lesson we reproduce the LangSlice out-of-stock bug, edit the add_pizza_to_order result at its checkpoint to the rejection it should have returned, and fork the run from there. With that one value changed, the agent tells the customer pineapple is out of stock. The defect sits in one missing check in one tool rather than in the model or the prompt. The lesson also covers how langgraph.json points Studio at your agent and how to set breakpoints on a node. Chapters: 0:00 What a trace can't answer 0:55 How to start LangGraph Studio with langgraph dev 1:43 How langgraph.json connects Studio to your agent 2:14 Reading the agent graph in...

articles.title: What is Tracing? | Introduction to LangSmith (2/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾An agent's reply shows what it said and hides the tool calls behind it. This lesson turns on LangSmith tracing for the LangSlice pizza agent, loads a batch of recorded customer conversations, and uses the trace views to find a bug the output never shows. The add_pizza_to_order tool sees that pineapple is out of stock and adds it to the order anyway, with no error raised. For agents built on LangChain's open-source frameworks, tracing takes three environment variables and no code changes. You'll also see how runs nest into traces and traces group into threads, and how to record your own helper functions with @traceable. Chapters: 0:00 Why an agent's output doesn't show how it got there 0:31 Runs, traces and threads in LangSmith 1:35 Meet the LangSlice pizza agent and its nine tools 2:45...

articles.title: LangSmith Overview | Introduction to LangSmith (1/12)
articles.author: LangChain
articles.summary: 💾A traditional program fails with a stack trace pointing at the line that broke. An agent can return a reasonable answer after choosing the wrong tools along the way, and nothing in the reply shows it. This first lesson of LangSmith Essentials explains why agents need a process that keeps improving them after they ship, the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC), and how the course maps each stage onto LangSmith. You'll also meet the agent we use for the whole series, an ordering assistant for a fictional pizzeria called LangSlice. It ships with two deliberate bugs for you to find. The main version is built with LangChain's create_agent, and a second version runs on the Claude Agent SDK, since LangSmith can trace either one.
